name: teamily
description: Teamily · AI agent team app (web + native iOS shell)

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp -R icons www/icons
scripts.serve: npm run build:web && npx http-server www -p 4173 -c-1
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
